name: 19425 · Chester Sprgs, PA
findings: ZIP 19425 (Chester Sprgs) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19425 (Chester Sprgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19425 (Chester Sprgs) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
